messages.author: cf47bbe63da1f3ae
messages.subject: vector[0] causes compile error
parts:
It's a pretty obvious problem, but the compilation error output asked me to file a bug report, so here it is :)
This R script / Stan model breaks  with Stan 2.9, R 3.2.1, and windows 7. I guess you need another check for vector dimensions or the like.

bug<-"
parameters{
vector[0] test;
}
model{
test~normal(0,1);
}"

bugnuts<-stan(model_code = c(bug),  data = list(test=c()))

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] vector[0] causes compile error
parts:
Thanks. We really do want to know about cases where the C++
code generated for a Stan program can't be compiled.

What's happening is that the Eigen Matrix constructor is confusing the
size 0 with the null pointer. This is all due to the flexibility of casting
integer literals in C++. Here's the issue:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/1909

I'll fix the bug in the code generator.

- Bob
